metadata.description: Compares Newton (B0), piecewise two-exponential (B1), coupled mass-energy ODE (C1), Bayesian change-point (C2), and flux-crossover with evaporation suppression (C3) across published coffee cooling datasets. Fit on first 80%, OOS evaluate on last 20%. Primary metric: time-to-drinkable (50°C crossing) prediction accuracy.

examples.input: Fit five coffee-cooling models (Newton, piecewise, coupled ODE, Bayesian change-point, flux-crossover) to the kurzweg_1988 dataset, fit on first 80%, evaluate OOS on last 20%, compute BIC and predicted time-to-drinkable (50°C crossing).
